$comment: Recording direction for the vignettes (src/content/vignettes.json holds the words; docs/reviews/2026-10-weight-of-absence.md the decisions). One voice per take; the other person is unspoken scene context. Every take is an audition take until the artist keeps it (scripts/generate-dialogue.mjs --vignettes --approve=…); only kept takes reach the room. Direction (the artist, after the first listen: 'too happy and expressive'): like the wall lines kept, quiet and sad, held back, whispered where close; never bright, amused or laughing (scripts/dialogue-lib.mjs BRIGHT_TAGS). The scene context carries the loss; it is never spoken.

sarah.identity: A young woman, soft-spoken but direct. Shy warmth, uncertainty she doesn't hide.

liam.identity: A young man. Quick to laugh, quick to bristle; embarrassed by his own feelings.

restrained.identity: A grounded, ordinary adult. Keeps composure; emotion gets through anyway. Never theatrical, never cold for effect.

bill.identity: An older man. Unhurried; the past is very near to him.

matilda.identity: A woman in middle age. Warm, tired, has carried other people for a long time.

warm.identity: Expressive and spontaneous, relaxed, laughs easily. Affectionate familiarity; happy memories told without sentiment.

young.library: Will (ElevenLabs default voice; a young adult voice, not a child)
young.identity: Youthful vulnerability: uncertainty, curiosity, the fragile feeling of being misunderstood. A synthetic stock voice; it imitates no real person.

small-voice.identity: The kept 'small voice' design (a small young-adult voice), directed as someone remembering being small. Saved to the account from small-voice-1.

older-woman.identity: The kept 'older woman' design, as a stranger (a shop assistant). Saved to the account from older-woman-2.
